title: Spotify Churn Radar
why: Spotify runs on monthly subscriptions and competes with Apple Music and YouTube Music for the same listeners. This tool scores every subscriber for churn risk, explains why, and assigns a retention play.
problem: A subscription business is experiencing increasing customer churn despite continued marketing expenditure. Develop an AI system that identifies behavioral patterns associated with churn, segments at-risk customers, determines potential causes, and generates personalized retention strategies.
data_note: 3,000 Premium subscribers with 90 days of listening, billing and support history, scaled 2,000x to a 6M-subscriber market (sample data).

steps.detail: Listening, skips, logins, billing, plan, support tickets, reviews
Change in weekly listening, days since login, failed payments
Per-user feature contributions (SHAP-style) and global drivers
Monthly hazard turned into expected months until cancel
Group by each user's top churn driver
Keyword sentiment on reviews and tickets
Rules + AI analyst pick an action per segment

questions: What is the biggest reason people cancel?
Which segment should we target first and why?
Write a win-back email for the price-sensitive group
How accurate is the churn model?
author: K Mohan Kumar
